candidates: Thumbnailer function environment variable OUTPUT_BUCKET (bucket name)
answer.explanation: Every Thumbnailer invocation from 00:21:39Z onward (about 1,050 errors in the 00:21–00:59 range, including all 00:47–00:57 invocations in the window) fails at handler.py line 43 with NoSuchBucket on S3.put_object(Bucket=OUTPUT_BUCKET). The error is a missing bucket, not AccessDenied, so the execution role is not the cause. The failure began about 26 minutes before the window and persists through it, which points to a changed OUTPUT_BUCKET value. The Uploader and Compression functions show no related errors. Limitation: I had no tool to read the live Lambda environment or the IaC template, so I could not confirm the bad bucket name or whether the value drifted from the template. The candidates are therefore unverified, and the IAC layer cannot be ruled out until the template is checked.
